extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of philosophy; scholars interested in Bergson, metaphysics of time, and theories of evolution
extracted.subtask_description: Close reading of a book chapter (Bergson's Creative Evolution) discussing metaphysical and epistemological issues about time, duration, evolution, and the limits of mechanistic or Kantian accounts.
